d:
Tyohar ki Rich Paneer Sabzi - bina pyaaz, lehsun, tamatar, cream aur mawa ke! Ghar ke paneer aur dahi se bani creamy gravy
Aaj Masala Kitchen mein main, Poonam Devnani, sikhaungi ki kaju, tarbooz aur kharbooze ke beej ki paste se paneer sabzi ko kaise rich banate hain.
Bonus: paneer ki jagah aloo, matar ya shimla mirch bhi daal sakte hain!
Bina pyaaz lehsun tamatar ki rich paneer sabzi ki poori recipe
Kaju, tarbooz, kharbooze ke beej se creamy paste
Dahi na phate - simple tricks
Masala oil se perfect lal rang
Comment karein - tyohar par aapke ghar mein kaunsi sabzi sabse pehle khatam hoti hai?
